QuestionStmt.S: Determine the frequency for which a $10\mu F$ capacitor has a reactance of $2 \times 10^{-3}\Omega$.

Solution.S:
Capacitive reactance: $X_C = \frac{1}{2\pi f C}$.

Given: $C = 10\mu F = 10 \times 10^{-6}$ F, $X_C = 2 \times 10^{-3}\Omega$.

$$f = \frac{1}{2\pi X_C C} = \frac{1}{2\pi \times 2 \times 10^{-3} \times 10 \times 10^{-6}}$$

$$= \frac{1}{2\pi \times 2 \times 10^{-8}} = \frac{1}{4\pi \times 10^{-8}} = \frac{10^8}{4\pi}$$

$$= \frac{25}{\pi} \times 10^6 \text{ Hz} = \frac{25}{\pi} \text{ MHz}$$

Final Answer: $$\boxed{\frac{25}{\pi} \text{ MHz}}$$

Hence, the correct option is A.
